company_facts: Arthrex describes itself as a leader in new product development and medical education in orthopedics (https://careers.arthrex.com/NorthAmerica/job/Naples-Technical-Artist-Intern-FL-34108/1373642157/)

Internship runs January-April 2027 in Naples, FL, minimum 25 hours/week, on the Medical Visualization team (https://careers.arthrex.com/NorthAmerica/job/Naples-Technical-Artist-Intern-FL-34108/1373642157/)

Benefits listed include medical insurance, onsite clinics, complimentary lunch and wellness center access (https://careers.arthrex.com/NorthAmerica/job/Naples-Technical-Artist-Intern-FL-34108/1373642157/)
mission_and_values: Tagline: 'Helping Surgeons Treat Their Patients Better' (https://careers.arthrex.com/NorthAmerica/job/Naples-Technical-Artist-Intern-FL-34108/1373642157/)
Focus on new product development and medical education in orthopedics (https://careers.arthrex.com/NorthAmerica/job/Naples-Technical-Artist-Intern-FL-34108/1373642157/)
technical_topics: creating 3D assets, textures and materials for anatomical models
shader development for real-time rendering in Unity and Unreal Engine
automation scripting and programming for art pipelines
CAD proficiency and tools such as Maya, Visual Studio
hr_topics: collaborating across teams on interactive visualization projects
why medical visualization and why Arthrex
managing a part-time internship schedule (25+ hours/week) alongside final semester
bridging software engineering skills with a creative team
technical_questions: Walk me through how a vertex shader differs from a fragment/pixel shader. What would you use each for on an anatomical model?
You have a 3D model with millions of polygons that must run smoothly in VR. How would you optimize it?
What is a transformation matrix, and how do you combine rotation, scale and translation?
Describe how you would write a script to batch-process a library of 3D assets (rename, validate, export).
What experience do you have with Unity or Unreal Engine, even in class or personal projects?
How would you test an interactive VR/AR experience for bugs?
Explain the difference between a texture, a material and a shader.
Tell me about a Python or C++ project you built and how you debugged it.
hr_questions: Why do you want to intern at Arthrex, and what draws you to medical visualization?
How does your work connect to the idea of helping surgeons treat patients better?
Tell me about a time you worked with people from a different discipline than yours.
Describe a time you had to learn a new tool or technology quickly.
Tell me about a time you received critical feedback and how you responded.
How would you balance a 25-hour work week with your final semester of classes?
